rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that a person is connected with a crime or wrongdoing.

example.english: That theft case does implicate several bank employees.
example.traditional: 嗰單盜竊案的確涉及幾個銀行職員。
example.jyutping: go2 daan1 dou6 sit3 on3 dik1 kok3 sip3 kap6 gei2 go3 ngan4 hong4 zik1 jyun4

rows.note: Use this when the involvement suggests that someone has been dragged into trouble or a criminal matter.

example.english: I don't want this lawsuit to implicate me.
example.traditional: 我唔想畀呢單官司牽連。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 bei2 ni1 daan1 gun1 si1 hin1 lin4

rows.traditional: 證據顯示 A 涉及 B
rows.jyutping: zing3 geoi3 hin2 si6 A sip3 kap6 B
rows.note: Use this construction when the subject is evidence or other findings that show A's connection with wrongdoing B.

example.english: The evidence does implicate this manager in falsifying the accounts.
example.traditional: 證據顯示呢個經理涉及造假賬目。
example.jyutping: zing3 geoi3 hin2 si6 ni1 go3 ging1 lei5 sip3 gap6 zou6 gaa2 zoeng3 muk6
